coverage: The whole goal-host-vessel live clone history in substrate-live (/workspace/git/vessels/goal-host-vessel, HEAD bc99f91 2026-09-28, 1,090 commits from 06-15 on). I read every non-autonomous commit subject (546). For all 544 autonomous commits I pulled the Gap trailer and shortstat, measured code-vs-comment churn, and read diffs for the oscillation clusters and the named gaps. I read the bodies of every revert and of key operator commits. I ran git log -G for 15 recurring identifiers. Structural map: a top-level anchor scan of src/index.ts at HEAD (17,910 lines), env-read inventory, dead/disabled markers, a callers check, and index.ts size over 8 dates. Runtime-use evidence comes from 7 days of goal-host journal (312k lines) plus the sizes of the reached-command cache and the verifier-recipes store. Skipped: line-by-line reading of the 382 route-edit diffs (only sampled); the other src/*.ts module histories (counted, not read); node 2 (compose2-live) clone.

problems.symptom: Shape resolves fail with an invalid URL or 'no producer' because callers join endpoint + absolute resolve URL, or pick a loopback address
problems.root_cause: No single URL-joining seam. asResolvePath's contract changed (09-20) without updating its 10 call sites, which are patched one gap at a time. Endpoint preference is a hand-coded heuristic that the drafter oscillates on.

problems.symptom: Edit or creation goals graded reached with nothing landed; oracles confirm wrong answers
problems.root_cause: Landing evidence is checked per goal kind at many sites. Duplicate stale blocks short-circuit the correct one. The landing ledger is node-local. Oracles are hand-written per family and each re-derives parsing.

problems.symptom: Autonomous landings that are comment-only, net zero, or oscillating (13 comment-only; clusters of 7, 7, 11 and 14 commits on one gap)
problems.root_cause: The gap is re-composed repeatedly with no idempotence or no-op check. -narrowed children can undo parents. Landings count as success without a behavioral delta.

problems.symptom: Drafts widen predicates, land in the wrong repo, delete out-of-scope code, or hardcode path hacks
problems.root_cause: Gates check typecheck, region and semantic judgement, not deletion scope or predicate widening. The drafter edits line windows of 4,500-line functions.

problems.symptom: Autonomous landing breaks tsc or crash-loops goal-host (duplicate let, un-awaited async)
problems.root_cause: Signature-subset staticEvaluate is not a full cross-file tsc. Full-file cutover from a stale base.

problems.symptom: Compose BUSY/503 falls through to a shell walk that cannot edit
problems.root_cause: The edit-intent routing decision is duplicated (EARLY route and late route) with separate status handling.

problems.symptom: Reached executions don't mint; learned pathways dropped; middle-tier rebind never selects
problems.root_cause: The mint path was gated on fields no producer set. The rebind cache is keyed to shapes the walk no longer targets (shape-mismatch).

problems.symptom: Arms only lose (beta without possible alpha), grades recorded at 2 of 8 sites, dispatcher pins a template at beta 8610
problems.root_cause: Credit assignment is spread across many sites in the walk. Pinned dispatchers bypass selection learning.

problems.symptom: Policy readers with no producer; verdicts and labels computed but not consumed; traces missing tags and consumed inputs
problems.root_cause: Readers shipped without producers, emitters inert, and no check that a written field has a reader.

problems.symptom: Behaviour behind env vars; a law-1 gap 'fixed' by defaulting the env gate OFF
problems.root_cause: 34 process.env reads in index.ts. The drafter satisfies the gap text literally.

problems.symptom: Concept recall slow, failing (relay ~40%) or hitting the wrong vessel or port
problems.root_cause: Recall crosses nodes through the relay; locality not handled.

problems.symptom: Landing probe blind to composes on the other node; double landing
problems.root_cause: The compose report is written on the owning node's filesystem.

problems.symptom: Same block inserted 10 times; the same change landed twice; duplicate in-flight dispatches
problems.root_cause: Gap drain re-composes without checking for an existing landing, and dedup guards exist per entry point.

problems.symptom: index.ts 17,910 lines; 3 functions about 7,950; dead gates and diagnostic sinks left in; 4 generations of reach grading coexist
problems.root_cause: Every fix is additive. Mechanisms are superseded but not retired.

problems.symptom: Ephemeris oracle 0/6,479, rebind 0/3,456, recipes and recipe seeding unused
problems.root_cause: Mechanisms were built for one goal family, validated once, and never retired.

problems.symptom: Stale-base cutover clobbers or re-inserts code; restarts leak in-flight dispatches
problems.root_cause: Full-file cutover staged against an old base SHA.

principles: A staged clone is not a reach (e830210)
Resolve the missing path, don't delete the requirement for one (eac995e)
Guarding the observed symptom lets the class recur; pin the call site, not only the rule (0789584, 7th recurrence)
Nothing checks that deletions are in scope; a self-contained deletion passes typecheck, region and semantic gates (496aebf)
A semantic widening of a predicate passes every gate; nothing fails closed (eac995e)
Enforce in code; stating it in the prompt does not hold (2c26fcb)
A failed producer lookup is not proof that no producer exists (f5c4052, d575161, 744ecd8)
Grade novel goal classes by independent recompute, and one model-authored command is not ground truth (aed9961, 2337624)
A reader without a producer is inert ('I shipped both readers, neither producer', f87f52f)
Law 1 applies to the operator's own constants too (4f7a817, 02f168c, ca286e0)
A signature-subset staticEvaluate is not a full tsc (f3953c0)
Pinning a target bypasses selection, not the evidence (runtime refusal text)
